name: @octocodeai/octocodecode
description: Octocode coding agent CLI with native tools, subagents, and session management

scripts.build:unbundled: yarn run clean && node ../../scripts/build-host-sources.mjs && shx chmod +x dist/cli.js dist/rpc-entry.js && yarn run copy-assets
scripts.build:binary: yarn workspace @octocodeai/octocode-contacts run build && yarn workspace @octocodeai/octocode-webview run build && yarn workspace @octocodeai/octocode-tui run build && yarn workspace @octocodeai/octocode-telemetry run build && yarn workspace @octocodeai/octocode-ai run build && yarn workspace @octocodeai/octocode-agent-core run build && yarn run build && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-bunfig --no-compile-autoload-dotenv ./dist/bun/cli.js ./src/utils/image-resize-worker.ts --outfile dist/binary/octocode && node ../../scripts/stage-binary.mjs dist/binary
scripts.copy-assets: shx mkdir -p dist/theme && shx cp src/theme/*.json dist/theme/ && shx mkdir -p dist/modes/interactive/assets && shx cp src/modes/interactive/assets/*.png dist/modes/interactive/assets/ && shx mkdir -p dist/core/export-html/vendor && shx cp src/core/export-html/template.html src/core/export-html/template.css src/core/export-html/template.js dist/core/export-html/ && shx cp src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js dist/core/export-html/vendor/ && shx mkdir -p dist/octocode/instructions && shx rm -rf dist/octocode/instructions/roles && shx cp -r src/octocode/instructions/roles dist/octocode/instructions/ && shx mkdir -p dist/licenses/codex-patch && shx cp src/octocode/shared/codex-patch/LICENSE src/octocode/shared/codex-patch/NOTICE dist/licenses/codex-patch/ && node ../../scripts/stage-bash-parser.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: yarn run clean && yarn run build

author: Mario Zechner
